newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hashimoto in Netherlands for EU/Japan summit.
newsitem.headline: Hashimoto in Netherlands for EU/Japan summit.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto arrived at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport on Tuesday ahead of a meeting with the European Union's presidency.
The annual Japan-EU summit opens in the Hague on Wednesday.
Hashimoto and his wife Kumiko were met by Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and his wife Rita shortly after the Japanese Prime Minister's plane touched down just after 1900 GMT.

EU officials in the Netherlands, which currently holds the EU presidency, are likely to want to press Hashimoto to expand on his comments made on Monday regarding Tokyo's huge holdings in U.S. treasuries which sent financial markets into a spin.

U.S. markets tumbled on Monday after Hashimoto's comments in New York on the need for foreign exchange stability were taken as a veiled threat by Japan to sell of its U.S. government bonds. Markets on Tuesday recovered after Japan soothed worries about Hashimoto's intentions.
